comments.author: Minos
comments.body_html:
I really like this mod, but I’m playing on 3.9.8, are you interested in supporting older popular versions of SPT for this mod?

Also, some interesting things to add if you ever get around to it would be to include the popup for the top bullet in mags. I’ve seen streamers look at the top of the mag to see what kind of bullet is on top, but that’s not something I plan on learning.

Regardless, thank you for the mod!
